verdict.rationale: Weave's Playground explicitly supports iterating on prompts against real models, with prompt editing, message retrying, model comparison, custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints for testing custom models, and reusable saved model presets — directly matching the story of iterating on prompts against real models and variables. Docs also note testing new LLMs and custom models against production traces for real-world variables. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and explicit detail on 'variables' (e.g., templated prompt inputs) beyond prompt/message editing.
